test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Q is third to the right of T and second to the left of P. Only two friends are sitting between U and V and V is not the neighbour of P or T. W is second to the right of R. Which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: V is to the immediate right of S
P is to the immediate left of R
W is to the immediate right of Q
S is to the immediate left of T

solution:
**Friends :** P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W

1) They are sitting around a circular table facing opposite the center.

2) Q is third to the right of T and second to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cef2bc700d0c3361fce535b1f5259c3975a45b15fe887e34052bb8ba1747864.png] 

3) V is not the neighbour of P or T and only two friends are sitting between U and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4b594cd70aeed40d37d2ccbe81579eed1d236ab7ef0f2267062b5e531d1d215.png] 

4) W is second to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d8f923ea0e19588be53fdff8ba09ac95aa05c5b3c7a5afc35e8e74b7d3d64f6.png] 

**Possible sitting arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdc205006d8988bd3c7416d34d11ea923ca9fddd0190618cc831f91bb0548f40.png] 

Let's check each option and identify which statement is correct:

1) V is to the immediate right of S → **Correct**

2) P is to the immediate left of R → Incorrect (Since Q is to the immediate left of R)

3) W is to the immediate right of Q → Incorrect (Since R is to the immediate right of Q)

4) S is to the immediate left of T → Incorrect (Since U is to the immediate left of T)

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
